  'python3',
  ['-c', 'from schedule_timeline_runtime import timeline_core_js; print(timeline_core_js())'],
  { cwd: templates, encoding: 'utf8' },
);

const rendererJs = execFileSync(
  'python3',
  ['-c', 'from schedule_schema_runtime import build_schema_renderer_js; print(build_schema_renderer_js(["WCONPROD","DATES"]))'],
  { cwd: templates, encoding: 'utf8' },
);

function isKeywordHeader(trimmed) {
  if (!trimmed || trimmed === '/' || trimmed.startsWith('--')) return false;
  const m = trimmed.toUpperCase().match(/^([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)\b/);
  if (!m) return false;
  // Well names like N001 contain digits — not SCHEDULE keywords.
  if (/[0-9]/.test(m[1])) return false;
  return true;
}

function assertBareBlockSlash(scheduleText, label) {
  const lines = String(scheduleText || '').split(/\n/);
  let checked = 0;
  const missing = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const t = lines[i].trim();
    if (!isKeywordHeader(t)) continue;
    const kw = t.split(/\s+/)[0].toUpperCase();
    if (kw === 'DATES' || kw === 'INCLUDE') continue;
    let sawRecord = false;
    let bare = false;
    for (let j = i + 1; j < lines.length; j++) {
      const u = lines[j].trim();
      if (!u || u.startsWith('--')) continue;
      if (isKeywordHeader(u)) break;
      if (u === '/') {
        bare = true;
        break;
      }
      sawRecord = true;
    }
    if (sawRecord) {
      checked += 1;
      if (!bare) missing.push(`${kw}@${i + 1}`);
    }
  }
  assert.equal(missing.length, 0, `${label}: missing bare '/' after ${missing.slice(0, 8).join(', ')}`);
  assert.ok(checked > 0, `${label}: expected at least one keyword table with records`);
  return checked;
}

const sandbox = {};
vm.runInNewContext(
  `${timelineJs}\nthis.parseScheduleTimeline=parseScheduleTimeline;\nthis.emitScheduleFromTimeline=emitScheduleFromTimeline;\nthis.runCommissioningRevise=runCommissioningRevise;`,
  sandbox,
);

// 1) Synthetic round-trip
const synthetic = [
  'DATES',
  '  1 JAN 2025 /',
  '/',
  'WCONHIST',
  '1043 OPEN LRAT 18.9 0 0 /',
  '1054 OPEN LRAT 16.38 1.765 0 3* 57 /',
  '/',
  'WCONPROD',
  "  'W1' OPEN ORAT 10 * /",
  '/',
].join('\n');
const emitted = sandbox.emitScheduleFromTimeline(sandbox.parseScheduleTimeline(synthetic, 't.inc'));
assertBareBlockSlash(emitted, 'synthetic-emit');
assert.match(emitted, /WCONHIST\n1043 OPEN LRAT 18\.9 0 0 \/\n1054 OPEN LRAT 16\.38 1\.765 0 3\* 57 \/\n\/\n\nWCONPROD/);
assert.match(emitted, /WCONPROD\n  'W1' OPEN ORAT 10 \* \/\n\//);

// 2) Combat baseline commissioning revise
const baseline = fs.readFileSync(path.join(combat, 'baseline.inc'), 'utf8');
const wells = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(combat, 'date_shift_map.json'), 'utf8')).wells;
const facts = wells.map((w) => ({ well: w.well, date: w.new_date }));
const revise = sandbox.runCommissioningRevise(baseline, facts, 'schedule.inc', {
  instruction_blob: 'REVISE',
});
assert.equal(revise.status, 'applied');
const combatChecked = assertBareBlockSlash(revise.generated_schedule, 'combat-revise');

// 3) CREATE renderer default: missing layout.block_terminator → slash_line (not none)
assert.match(
  rendererJs,
  /block_terminator:clean\(l\.block_terminator\)\.toUpperCase\(\)==='NONE'\?'none':'slash_line'/,
);

console.log(
  `SCHEDULE block-terminator smoke: passed (synthetic + combat revise tables=${combatChecked})`,
);

function toItem(payload) {
  return { json: payload };
}

async function run(name, json, nodes = {}) {
  const resolved = { ...nodes };
  const lookup = (nodeName) => {
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(resolved, nodeName)) {
      throw new Error(`node not executed: ${nodeName}`);
    }
    const payload = resolved[nodeName];
    const items = Array.isArray(payload) ? payload.map(toItem) : [toItem(payload)];
    return { first: () => items[0], all: () => items };
  };
  const fn = new AsyncFunction('$json', '$', '$input', sourceCode(name));
  const result = await fn(json, lookup, { first: () => ({ json }), all: () => [{ json }] });
  assert.ok(Array.isArray(result) && result[0]?.json);
  return result[0].json;
}

(async () => {
  const prepared = await run(
    'Prepare AI Agent input',
    {
      objective: 'Поставь ORAT 80 на скважины, не трогай факт',
      handoff_message: 'WCONPROD прогноз, baseline.inc не query',
      inspect: { wells: ['101'] },
      fact_count: 2,
      facts_preview: [],
      session_id: 'sess-s',
      engineer_answers: [{ question_id: 'unlisted_wells_policy', choice: 'keep', label: 'Оставить как в исходном файле' }],
    },
    {
      'Normalize schedule task': {
        agent_task: { objective: 'Поставь ORAT 80 на скважины, не трогай факт', inputs: { rework_reason: 'Скважина 1602 не сдвинута' } },
      },
    },
  );
  const plannerInput = JSON.parse(prepared.planner_input);

  // Summarize AI steps: a result exists after apply_* or ask_engineer → fetch it; otherwise the
  // fallback question to the engineer is plain Russian (no tool names, ids or enums).
  const MACHINE = /[a-z]+_[a-z_]+|[a-z_]+=[a-z0-9]+|[{}[\]]/;
  const opened = { 'Open schedule session': { task_id: 'T-1', session_id: 'sess-s' } };
  const asked = await run(
    'Summarize AI steps',
    {
      output: 'Спросил инженера, в какую группу поместить скважину.',
      intermediateSteps: [{ action: { tool: 'inspect_schedule' } }, { action: { tool: 'ask_engineer' } }],
    },
    opened,
  );
  assert.equal(asked.skip_fetch, false);
  assert.equal(asked.has_result, true);
  assert.equal(asked.status_message, 'Спросил инженера, в какую группу поместить скважину.');
  const applied = await run(

    'Format missing schedule',

'use strict';

// schedule_datetime: parse DATES forms ↔ valid Date ↔ emit DATES keyword form.
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process');
const path = require('node:path');
const vm = require('node:vm');

const workspace = process.env.WORKSPACE_ROOT || path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const py = path.join(workspace, 'n8n', 'templates', 'schedule_timeline_runtime.py');
const coreJs = execFileSync(
  'python3',
  ['-c', 'from schedule_timeline_runtime import timeline_core_js; print(timeline_core_js())'],
  { cwd: path.dirname(py), encoding: 'utf8' },
);

const sandbox = {};
vm.runInNewContext(
  `${coreJs}
this.parseScheduleDate=parseScheduleDate;
this.formatDatesTnav=formatDatesTnav;
this.parseScheduleTimeline=parseScheduleTimeline;
this.emitScheduleFromTimeline=emitScheduleFromTimeline;
this.editCommissioningDatesOnTimeline=editCommissioningDatesOnTimeline;
`,
  sandbox,
);

// Parse forms
for (const [raw, iso, tnav] of [
  ['1 JAN 2020', '2020-01-01', '1 JAN 2020'],
  ['23 FEB 2020', '2020-02-23', '23 FEB 2020'],
  ['2020-02-23', '2020-02-23', '23 FEB 2020'],
  ['43884', '2020-02-23', '23 FEB 2020'], // Excel serial
  ['23.02.2020', '2020-02-23', '23 FEB 2020'],
  ['2020-02-23T00:00:00.000Z', '2020-02-23', '23 FEB 2020'],
]) {
  const d = sandbox.parseScheduleDate(raw);
  assert.ok(d, `parse ${raw}`);
  assert.equal(d.contract, 'schedule_datetime');
  assert.equal(Object.prototype.toString.call(d.value), '[object Date]');
  assert.equal(d.iso, iso);
  assert.equal(d.tnav, tnav);
  assert.equal(sandbox.formatDatesTnav(d), tnav);
  assert.equal(d.value.toISOString().slice(0, 10), iso);
}

assert.equal(sandbox.parseScheduleDate('31 FEB 2020'), null);
assert.equal(sandbox.parseScheduleDate('not-a-date'), null);

// Timeline step carries schedule_datetime; emit rebuilds DATES body from it
const text = [
  'DATES',
  '  1 JAN 2020 /',
  '/',
  'WCONPROD',
  '  1601 OPEN GRAT 1* 1* 200000 1* 1* 90 1* 30 /',
  '/',
  'DATES',
  '  1 FEB 2020 /',
  '/',
].join('\n');
const model = sandbox.parseScheduleTimeline(text, 't.inc');
assert.equal(model.contract_version, '1.1');
assert.ok(model.steps[1].date);
assert.equal(Object.prototype.toString.call(model.steps[1].date.value), '[object Date]');
assert.equal(model.steps[1].date.tnav, '1 JAN 2020');

const edited = sandbox.editCommissioningDatesOnTimeline(model, [{ well: '1601', date: '23 FEB 2020' }]);
assert.equal(edited.status, 'applied');
const out = sandbox.emitScheduleFromTimeline(edited.model);
assert.match(out, /DATES\n\s*23 FEB 2020 \//);
assert.match(out, /1601 OPEN GRAT/);

// Round-trip: emit → parse preserves calendar day
const again = sandbox.parseScheduleTimeline(out, 'out.inc');
const hit = again.steps.find((s) => s.date && s.date.iso === '2020-02-23');
assert.ok(hit);
assert.equal(hit.date.tnav, '23 FEB 2020');
assert.equal(Object.prototype.toString.call(hit.date.value), '[object Date]');

// JSON boundary: Date may stringify — parseScheduleDate revives a real Date
const serialized = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(hit.date));
const revived = sandbox.parseScheduleDate(serialized);
assert.ok(revived);
assert.equal(Object.prototype.toString.call(revived.value), '[object Date]');
assert.equal(revived.iso, '2020-02-23');
assert.equal(revived.tnav, '23 FEB 2020');

console.log('SCHEDULE datetime parse/emit smoke: passed');

'use strict';

// Stage-3 timeline emit: within each DATES step, keyword blocks follow WITHIN_DATE_KEYWORD_ORDER.
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process');
const path = require('node:path');
const vm = require('node:vm');

const workspace = process.env.WORKSPACE_ROOT || path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const py = path.join(workspace, 'n8n', 'templates', 'schedule_timeline_runtime.py');

const coreJs = execFileSync(
  'python3',
  ['-c', 'from schedule_timeline_runtime import timeline_core_js; print(timeline_core_js())'],
  { cwd: path.dirname(py), encoding: 'utf8' },
);

const sandbox = {};
vm.runInNewContext(`${coreJs}\nthis.parseScheduleTimeline=parseScheduleTimeline;\nthis.emitScheduleFromTimeline=emitScheduleFromTimeline;`, sandbox);

const text = [
  'DATES',
  '  1 JAN 2025 /',
  '/',
  'APPLYSCRIPT',
  "  'hook.py' 'on_step' /",
  '/',
  'WCONPROD',
  "  'W1' OPEN ORAT 10 * /",
  '/',
  'WELSPECS',
  "  'W1' 'G1' 1 1 1* OIL /",
  '/',
  'DATES',
  '  1 FEB 2025 /',
  '/',
  'WCONPROD',
  "  'W2' OPEN ORAT 20 * /",
  '/',
].join('\n');

const model = sandbox.parseScheduleTimeline(text, 'schedule.inc');
const out = sandbox.emitScheduleFromTimeline(model);
const headers = out.split('\n').filter((line) => /^(DATES|WELSPECS|WCONPROD|APPLYSCRIPT)\b/.test(line.trim()));
assert.deepEqual(headers, ['DATES', 'WELSPECS', 'WCONPROD', 'APPLYSCRIPT', 'DATES', 'WCONPROD']);

// ECLIPSE/tNav: every keyword table with records must end with a bare '/' before the next keyword/DATES.
function assertBareBlockSlash(scheduleText) {
  const lines = scheduleText.split('\n');
  const isHeader = (t) => /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*\b/.test(t) && t !== '/';
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const t = lines[i].trim();
    if (!t || t.startsWith('--') || !isHeader(t)) continue;
    const kw = t.split(/\s+/)[0].toUpperCase();
    if (kw === 'DATES') continue; // DATES emitted via dates_header/body
    let sawRecord = false;
    let bare = false;
    for (let j = i + 1; j < lines.length; j++) {
      const u = lines[j].trim();
      if (!u || u.startsWith('--')) continue;
      if (isHeader(u)) break;
      if (u === '/') {
        bare = true;
        break;
      }
      sawRecord = true;
    }
    if (sawRecord) {
      assert.equal(bare, true, `missing bare block-closing '/' after ${kw} at line ${i + 1}`);
    }
  }
}
assertBareBlockSlash(out);
assertBareBlockSlash(text); // round-trip input already had them

console.log('SCHEDULE timeline within-date emit order smoke: passed');

'use strict';

// Variant A: unlisted_wells_policy remove requires explicit enum; prose alone → needs_input.
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const vm = require('node:vm');

const workspace = process.env.WORKSPACE_ROOT || path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const templates = path.join(workspace, 'n8n', 'templates');
const combat = path.join(workspace, 'simulation-model-example', 'combat-dates-revise');

const coreJs = execFileSync(
  'python3',
  ['-c', 'from schedule_timeline_runtime import timeline_core_js; print(timeline_core_js())'],
  { cwd: templates, encoding: 'utf8' },
);

const sandbox = {};
vm.runInNewContext(
  `${coreJs}\nthis.runCommissioningRevise=runCommissioningRevise;\nthis.detectUnlistedWellsPolicy=detectUnlistedWellsPolicy;`,
  sandbox,
);

const baseline = fs.readFileSync(path.join(combat, 'baseline.inc'), 'utf8');
const wells = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(combat, 'date_shift_map.json'), 'utf8')).wells;
const allFacts = wells.map((w) => ({ well: w.well, date: w.new_date }));
const halfWells = new Set(['304R', '295R', '1601', '1602']);
const halfFacts = allFacts.filter((f) => halfWells.has(f.well));

const proseRemove =
  'REVISE прогнозный SCHEDULE по Excel с датами ввода. В Excel не все скважины: тех скважин, которые есть в примере schedule но нет в файле с запусками — убрать.';
const proseKeep =
  'REVISE прогнозный SCHEDULE: сдвинуть даты ввода по Excel. Инструкция молчит про скважины, которых нет в Excel — по умолчанию сохранить их запуски.';
const humanCase0 =
  'Во вложении excel файл с новыми датами ввода скважин. Используй эти новые даты для обновления прогнозного schedule файла, который так же во вложении.';

assert.equal(sandbox.detectUnlistedWellsPolicy(proseRemove), 'remove');
assert.equal(sandbox.detectUnlistedWellsPolicy(proseKeep), 'keep');
assert.equal(sandbox.detectUnlistedWellsPolicy(humanCase0), 'keep');

// 1) Prose remove, no explicit enum, half Excel → HITL
const hitl = sandbox.runCommissioningRevise(baseline, halfFacts, 'schedule.inc', {
  instruction_blob: proseRemove,
});
assert.equal(hitl.status, 'needs_input');
assert.equal(hitl.generated_schedule, '');
assert.ok((hitl.findings || []).some((f) => f.code === 'UNLISTED_WELLS_POLICY_REQUIRED'));
assert.ok((hitl.questions || []).some((q) => q.id === 'unlisted_wells_policy'));
assert.ok((hitl.unlisted_wells || []).length >= 1);

// 2) Explicit remove + same facts → applied
const removed = sandbox.runCommissioningRevise(baseline, halfFacts, 'schedule.inc', {
  instruction_blob: proseRemove,
  unlisted_wells_policy: 'remove',
});
assert.equal(removed.status, 'applied');
assert.equal(removed.unlisted_wells_policy, 'remove');
assert.ok((removed.generated_schedule || '').length > 0);
assert.ok((removed.removed || []).length > 0 || (removed.unlisted_wells || []).length > 0);

// 3) Case0-style human RU, full wells → applied keep
const c0 = sandbox.runCommissioningRevise(baseline, allFacts, 'schedule.inc', {
  instruction_blob: humanCase0,
});
assert.equal(c0.status, 'applied');
assert.equal(c0.unlisted_wells_policy, 'keep');
assert.equal((c0.unlisted_wells || []).length, 0);

// 4) Silent / keep prose, half Excel → applied keep, unlisted preserved
const kept = sandbox.runCommissioningRevise(baseline, halfFacts, 'schedule.inc', {
  instruction_blob: proseKeep,
});
assert.equal(kept.status, 'applied');
assert.equal(kept.unlisted_wells_policy, 'keep');
assert.ok((kept.unlisted_wells || []).length >= 1);
assert.ok(
  /201\b/.test(kept.generated_schedule) || /208\b/.test(kept.generated_schedule),
  'unlisted commissioning wells should remain under keep',
);

console.log('SCHEDULE unlisted-wells policy HITL smoke: passed (4 scenarios)');

Python twin: state_shape.sanitize_plan / plan_open_items. */\nconst PLAN_STATUSES=[\"pending\", \"active\", \"done\", \"blocked\", \"dropped\"];\nconst PLAN_OPEN_STATUSES=[\"pending\", \"active\", \"blocked\"];\nconst PLAN_MAX_ITEMS=12;\nfunction sanitizeAsked(names){\n  const out=[]; const seen=new Set();\n  for(const raw of (Array.isArray(names)?names:[])){\n    const n=String(raw==null?'':raw).trim();\n    if(!/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,39}$/.test(n)||seen.has(n)) continue;\n    seen.add(n); out.push(n);\n    if(out.length>=6) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\nfunction sanitizePlanItem(item){\n  if(!item||typeof item!=='object'||Array.isArray(item)) return null;\n  const id=String(item.id==null?'':item.id).trim().slice(0,40);\n  if(!id) return null;\n  const out={id,title:String(item.title||'').trim().slice(0,200),status:PLAN_STATUSES.includes(String(item.status||''))?String(item.status):'pending'};\n  const agentId=String(item.agent_id||'').trim();\n  if(agentId) out.agent_id=agentId;\n  const deps=(Array.isArray(item.depends_on)?item.depends_on:[]).map(d=>String(d==null?'':d).trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,8);\n  if(deps.length) out.depends_on=deps;\n  const note=String(item.note||'').trim().slice(0,300);\n  if(note) out.note=note;\n  const asked=sanitizeAsked(item.asked);\n  if(asked.length) out.asked=asked;\n  return out;\n}\nfunction sanitizePlan(plan){\n  const out=[];const seen=new Set();\n  for(const raw of (Array.isArray(plan)?plan:[])){\n    const item=sanitizePlanItem(raw);\n    if(!item||seen.has(item.id)) continue;\n    seen.add(item.id); out.push(item);\n    if(out.length>=PLAN_MAX_ITEMS) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\n/* agent_id as the model wrote it → registry id (the model tends to write the agent's title instead). */\nfunction planAgentId(value, registry){\n  const v=String(value||'').trim();\n  if(!v) return '';\n  const rows=Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[];\n  if(!rows.length) return v;\n  const byId=rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===v);\n  if(byId) return v;\n  const byTitle=rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.title||'').trim().toLowerCase()===v.toLowerCase());\n  return byTitle?String(byTitle.agent_id):'';\n}\n/* Merge `plan_update` into state.plan. Items match by id; an item without id is rejected — the model wrote\n   «step 1 — agent X» prose instead of a plan row (CASE-6a9fa129-5ae077: the whole plan was lost that way).\n   Fields the update omits keep their previous value. Returns {accepted, rejected}. */\nfunction applyPlanUpdate(state, updates, registry){\n  const plan=sanitizePlan(state.plan);\n  const by=new Map(plan.map(p=>[p.id,p]));\n  let accepted=0, rejected=0;\n  for(const raw of (Array.isArray(updates)?updates:[])){\n    const item=sanitizePlanItem(raw);\n    if(!item){rejected+=1;continue;}\n    const prev=by.get(item.id);\n    if(!prev&&by.size>=PLAN_MAX_ITEMS){rejected+=1;continue;}\n    const merged={...(prev||{}),...item};\n    if(!item.title&&prev&&prev.title) merged.title=prev.title;\n    if((raw.status===undefined||raw.status===null||raw.status==='')&&prev) merged.status=prev.status;\n    if(!merged.title) merged.title=merged.id;\n    const agentId=planAgentId(merged.agent_id, registry);\n    if(agentId) merged.agent_id=agentId; else delete merged.agent_id;\n    /* asked is orchestrator-owned (expected_output names). The model must not set it via plan_update. */\n    if(prev&&prev.asked&&prev.asked.length) merged.asked=prev.asked; else delete merged.asked;\n    by.set(item.id,merged); accepted+=1;\n  }\n  state.plan=[...by.values()];\n  return {accepted,rejected};\n}\n/* Actions drive statuses (flags are the model's habit, actions are its intent): the plan item the call\n   names (action.task_id) becomes active — else the first pending item of the agent being called; when\n   that agent returns completed, its active item is done, and leftover open items it owns close too if\n   the slot already has every asked key (expected_output.datasets names) or, if none were asked,\n   every output_provides key (a second handoff without new input is a loop). */\nfunction planMarkAgentActive(state, agentId, taskId, askedNames){\n  const plan=sanitizePlan(state.plan);\n  const id=String(agentId||'').trim();\n  const named=planItemForCall(plan, id, taskId);\n  const asked=sanitizeAsked(askedNames);\n  if(named){\n    named.status='active';\n    if(asked.length) named.asked=asked; else delete named.asked;\n  } else if(id&&!plan.some(p=>p.agent_id===id&&p.status==='active')){\n    const next=plan.find(p=>p.agent_id===id&&p.status==='pending');\n    if(next){\n      next.status='active';\n      if(asked.length) next.asked=asked; else delete next.asked;\n    }\n  }\n  state.plan=plan;\n}\n/* The plan item a call_agent names: action.task_id equal to an item id owned by that agent (or unowned).\n   Returns the item object of the array given (callers mutate it), not a sanitized copy. */\nfunction planItemForCall(plan, agentId, taskId){\n  const tid=String(taskId||'').trim();\n  if(!tid) return null;\n  const item=(Array.isArray(plan)?plan:[]).find(p=>p&&String(p.id||'')===tid);\n  if(!item) return null;\n  return (!item.agent_id||String(item.agent_id)===String(agentId||'').trim())?item:null;\n}\n/* A second call to an agent that already completed is new work — not a repeat — when it names an open\n   plan item other than the one the agent completed (CASE-6aa00e09-c6d71f: two results as two items; the\n   second call was sent to review as a repeat and the case finished without the next agent). Leftover\n   items of a completed agent are not open once its data already has every asked key, or — when\n   the call named no expected_output — every output_provides key (CASE-6aa029de-c5e23d: a second\n   handoff without new input is a loop; CASE-6aa00e09-c6d71f: facts-only without asked leaves p2\n   open). The plan is capped\n   (PLAN_MAX_ITEMS) and every step costs budget, so this cannot loop. */\nfunction planNamesNewWork(state, agentId, taskId){\n  const item=planItemForCall(sanitizePlan(state.plan), agentId, taskId);\n  if(!item||!PLAN_OPEN_STATUSES.includes(item.status)) return false;\n  const doneTasks=new Set(ledgerAgentEntries(state, agentId).filter(e=>e.status==='completed').map(e=>String(e.task_id||'')));\n  return !doneTasks.has(item.id);\n}\nfunction registryProvides(registry, agentId){\n  const row=(Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[]).find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===String(agentId||'').trim());\n  if(!row) return [];\n  let vals=row.output_provides;\n  if(typeof vals==='string'){ try{vals=JSON.parse(vals);}catch{vals=[];} }\n  return (Array.isArray(vals)?vals:[]).map(v=>String(v||'').trim()).filter(Boolean);\n}\nfunction leftoverCloseKeys(state, agentId, registry){\n  const asked=[]; const seen=new Set();\n  for(const p of sanitizePlan(state.plan)){\n    if(String(p.agent_id||'')!==String(agentId||'').trim()) continue;\n    for(const k of sanitizeAsked(p.asked)){\n      if(seen.has(k)) continue;\n      seen.add(k); asked.push(k);\n    }\n  }\n  if(asked.length) return asked;\n  return registryProvides(registry, agentId);\n}\nfunction agentDataCoversProvides(state, agentId, registry){\n  const provides=leftoverCloseKeys(state, agentId, registry);\n  if(!provides.length) return false;\n  const raw=(state.agents||{})[agentId];\n  const slot=raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};\n  const data=slot.data&&typeof slot.data==='object'&&!Array.isArray(slot.data)?slot.data:{};\n  const keys=new Set([...(Array.isArray(slot.data_keys)?slot.data_keys:[]), ...Object.keys(data)].map(String));\n  keys.delete('omitted_keys');\n  return provides.every(k=>keys.has(k));\n}\nfunction planMarkAgentDone(state, agentId, registry){\n  const plan=sanitizePlan(state.plan);\n  const id=String(agentId||'').trim();\n  const coverAll=agentDataCoversProvides(state, id, registry);\n  for(const p of plan){\n    if(!id||p.agent_id!==id) continue;\n    if(p.status==='active'||(coverAll&&p.status==='pending')) p.status='done';\n  }\n  state.plan=plan;\n}\nfunction planOpenItems(plan){\n  return sanitizePlan(plan).filter(p=>PLAN_OPEN_STATUSES.includes(p.status));\n}\n/* The plan as the Decision LLM (and the completion check) read it in planner_input. */\nfunction planLines(plan){\n  return sanitizePlan(plan).map(p=>{\n    const agent=p.agent_id?` — agent_id: ${p.agent_id}`:'';\n    const deps=(p.depends_on||[]).length?` (после: ${p.depends_on.join(', ')})`:'';\n    const note=p.note?` — ${p.note}`:'';\n    return `- ${p.id} [${p.status}] ${p.title}${agent}${deps}${note}`;\n  });\n}\n/* RAG tag branch from the plan (no regex over the goal): the open plan items name agents, the registry\n   names what those agents consume/produce (input_required / output_provides — artifact roles and data\n   keys). Routing cards carry the same role words in `topics`, so the cards for the agents the model\n   intends to use are boosted. Empty plan → empty tags → lexical/semantic branches only. */\nfunction planRetrievalTopics(plan, registry){\n  const rows=Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[];\n  const out=[];\n  for(const p of planOpenItems(plan)){\n    const row=p.agent_id?rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===p.agent_id):null;\n    if(!row) continue;\n    for(const key of ['input_required','output_provides']){\n      let vals=row[key];\n      if(typeof vals==='string'){ try{vals=JSON.parse(vals);}catch{vals=[];} }\n      for(const v of (Array.isArray(vals)?vals:[])){\n        const tag=String(v||'').trim().toLowerCase();\n        if(tag&&!out.includes(tag)) out.push(tag);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return out.slice(0,12);\n}\n/* Shape the callee should produce: datasets the Decision LLM named (latin identifiers, known field\n   types) plus consumers — open plan items of *other* agents and what their input_schema.data lists.\n   Domain-free: names come from the registry / the LLM, not from Excel or SCHEDULE. Empty → omitted\n   from agent_task.inputs (existing commissioning calls stay unchanged). */\nfunction datasetName(v){\n  const t=String(v||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[-\\s]+/g,'_');\n  return /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$/.test(t)?t:'';\n}\nfunction sanitizeExpectedDatasets(raw){\n  const types=new Set(['text','number','date','boolean']);\n  const out=[];\n  for(const item of (Array.isArray(raw)?raw:[])){\n    if(!item||typeof item!=='object'||Array.isArray(item)) continue;\n    const name=datasetName(item.name);\n    if(!name||out.some(d=>d.name===name)) continue;\n    const fields=[];\n    for(const f of (Array.isArray(item.fields)?item.fields:[])){\n      const fname=datasetName(f&&typeof f==='object'?f.name:f);\n      if(!fname||fields.some(x=>x.name===fname)) entry={name,fields};\n    const desc=String(item.description||'').trim().slice(0,240);\n    if(desc) entry.description=desc;\n    out.push(entry);\n    if(out.length>=6) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\nfunction expectedConsumersFromPlan(state, registry, calleeId){\n  const skip=String(calleeId||'').trim();\n  const rows=Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[];\n  const out=[];\n  for(const p of planOpenItems(state&&state.plan)){\n    const id=String(p.agent_id||'').trim();\n    if(!id||id===skip) continue;\n    const row=rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===id);\n    if(!row) continue;\n '\n    :`${title} уже выполнил эту задачу, новых данных с тех пор не появилось. `;\n  const body=summary?`Результат: ${summary}. `:'';\n  /* The plan still has steps for agents that have not run: accepting this result closes only this\n     agent's part (review_scope 'agent'), the orchestrator goes on with the plan. */\n  const rest=reason==='step_limit'?[]:planOpenForUnstartedAgents(state, agentId);\n  const scope=rest.length?'agent':'case';\n  const restTitles=rest.map(p=>String(p.title||'').trim()).filter(t=>t&&!looksMachineText(t)).slice(0,3);\n  const ask=scope==='agent'\n    ?`Принять этот результат и продолжить остальные шаги${restTitles.length?` (${restTitles.join('; ')})`:''} или нужна доработка? Если доработка — напишите, что именно не так.';\n  return {\n    question_id:`result_review_${Number(state.step_count||0)}`,\n    kind:'result_approval',\n    review_scope:scope,\n    question:`${lead}${body}${ask}`,\n    options:[\n      {value:'accept',label:scope==='agent'?'Принять результат и продолжить':'Принять результат'},\n      {value:'rework',label:'Нужна доработка — опишу ниже'}\n    ]\n  };\n}\n/* Completion check (a second LLM pass) said the proposed finish leaves parts of the goal uncovered,\n   and the orchestrator already had one more step to close them: let the engineer decide. */\nfunction buildCompletionReviewQuestion(state, registry, uncovered, verdict){\n  const done=composeDoneSummary(state, registry);\n  const gaps=(Array.isArray(uncovered)?uncovered:[]).map(s=>String(s||'').trim()).filter(Boolean);\n  const gapText=gaps.length?`Не хватает: ${gaps.join('; ')}. `:'';\n  const doneText=done?`Сделано: ${done}. `:'';\n  const lead=String(verdict||'').trim()&&!looksMachineText(verdict)?`${String(verdict).trim().replace(/\\.?$/,'.')} `:'';\n  return {\n    question_id:`result_review_${Number(state.step_count||0)}`,\n    kind:'result_approval',\n    question:`Оркестратор считает задачу выполненной, но проверка нашла пробел. ${lead}${doneText}${gapText}Принять результат как есть или продолжить работу? Если продолжить — напишите, что именно нужно получить.`,\n    options:[\n      {value:'accept',label:'Принять результат как есть'},\n      {value:'rework',label:'Продолжить — опишу ниже'}\n    ]\n  };\n}\nfunction compactLedger(state){\n  const l=sanitizeLedger(state.ledger);\n  const rows=l.history.slice(-8).map(e=>{\n    if(e.kind==='human'){\n      return {step:e.step,kind:'human',question:String(e.question||'').slice(0,120),answer:String(e.answer||'').slice(0,160),...(e.review_accept?{review_accept:true,review_scope:e.review_scope==='agent'?'agent':'case'}:{})};\n    }\n    if(e.kind==='verification'){\n      return {step:e.step,kind:'verification',verdict:'rejected',uncovered:(Array.isArray(e.uncovered)?e.uncovered:[]).slice(0,6).map(s=>String(s).slice(0,160))};\n    }\n    return {\n      step:e.step,kind:'agent',agent_id:e.agent_id||null,task_id:e.task_id||null,status:e.status||null,\n      summary:String(e.summary||'').slice(0,240),\n      artifacts_added:Array.isArray(e.artifacts_added)?e.artifacts_added.slice(0,8):[],\n      ...(e.rework_reason?{rework_reason:String(e.rework_reason).slice(0,160)}:{})\n    };\n  });\n  return {history:rows,stall_count:l.stall_count,completed_agents:[...new Set(l.history.filter(e=>e.kind==='agent'&&e.status==='completed').map(e=>e.agent_id).filter(Boolean))]};\n}\n/* Plan (O13): the orchestrator's own decomposition of the goal — a short list of results to obtain, each\n   optionally owned by an agent. The Decision LLM writes it through `plan_update`; deterministic code keeps\n   it in step with what actually happened (call_agent → active, agent completed → done) and the finish guard\n   treats open items as uncovered parts. Python twin: state_shape.sanitize_plan / plan_open_items. */\nconst PLAN_STATUSES=[\"pending\", \"active\", \"done\", \"blocked\", \"dropped\"];\nconst PLAN_OPEN_STATUSES=[\"pending\", \"active\", \"blocked\"];\nconst PLAN_MAX_ITEMS=12;\nfunction sanitizeAsked(names){\n  const out=[]; const seen=new Set();\n  for(const raw of (Array.isArray(names)?names:[])){\n    const n=String(raw==null?'':raw).trim();\n    if(!/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,39}$/.test(n)||seen.has(n)) continue;\n    seen.add(n); out.push(n);\n    if(out.length>=6) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\nfunction sanitizePlanItem(item){\n  if(!item||typeof item!=='object'||Array.isArray(item)) return null;\n  const id=String(item.id==null?'':item.id).trim().slice(0,40);\n  if(!id) return null;\n  const out={id,title:String(item.title||'').trim().slice(0,200),status:PLAN_STATUSES.includes(String(item.status||''))?String(item.status):'pending'};\n  const agentId=String(item.agent_id||'').trim();\n  if(agentId) out.agent_id=agentId;\n  const deps=(Array.isArray(item.depends_on)?item.depends_on:[]).map(d=>String(d==null?'':d).trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,8);\n  if(deps.length) out.depends_on=deps;\n  const note=String(item.note||'').trim().slice(0,300);\n  if(note) out.note=note;\n  const asked=sanitizeAsked(item.asked);\n  if(asked.length) out.asked=asked;\n  return out;\n}\nfunction sanitizePlan(plan){\n  const out=[];const seen=new Set();\n  for(const raw of (Array.isArray(plan)?plan:[])){\n    const item=sanitizePlanItem(raw);\n    if(!item||seen.has(item.id)) continue;\n    seen.add(item.id); out.push(item);\n    if(out.length>=PLAN_MAX_ITEMS) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\n/* agent_id as the model wrote it → registry id (the model tends to write the agent's title instead). */\nfunction planAgentId(value, registry){\n  const v=String(value||'').trim();\n  if(!v) return '';\n  const rows=Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[];\n  if(!rows.length) return v;\n  const byId=rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===v);\n  if(byId) return v;\n  const byTitle=rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.title||'').trim().toLowerCase()===v.toLowerCase());\n  return byTitle?String(byTitle.agent_id):'';\n}\n/* Merge `plan_update` into state.plan. Items match by id; an item without id is rejected — the model wrote\n   «step 1 — agent X» prose instead of a plan row (CASE-6a9fa129-5ae077: the whole plan was lost that way).\n   Fields the update omits keep their previous value. Returns {accepted, rejected}. */\nfunction applyPlanUpdate(state, updates, registry){\n  const plan=sanitizePlan(state.plan);\n  const by=new Map(plan.map(p=>[p.id,p]));\n  let accepted=0, rejected=0;\n  for(const raw of (Array.isArray(updates)?updates:[])){\n    const item=sanitizePlanItem(raw);\n    if(!item){rejected+=1;continue;}\n    const prev=by.get(item.id);\n    if(!prev&&by.size>=PLAN_MAX_ITEMS){rejected+=1;continue;}\n    const merged={...(prev||{}),...item};\n    if(!item.title&&prev&&prev.title) merged.title=prev.title;\n    if((raw.status===undefined||raw.status===null||raw.status==='')&&prev) merged.status=prev.status;\n    if(!merged.title) merged.title=merged.id;\n    const agentId=planAgentId(merged.agent_id, registry);\n    if(agentId) merged.agent_id=agentId; else delete merged.agent_id;\n    /* asked is orchestrator-owned (expected_output names). The model must not set it via plan_update. */\n    if(prev&&prev.asked&&prev.asked.length) merged.asked=prev.asked; else delete merged.asked;\n    by.set(item.id,merged); accepted+=1;\n  }\n  state.plan=[...by.values()];\n  return {accepted,rejected};\n}\n/* Actions drive statuses (flags are the model's habit, actions are its intent): the plan item the call\n   names (action.task_id) becomes active — else the first pending item of the agent being called; when\n   that agent returns completed, its active item is done, and leftover open items it owns close too if\n   the slot already has every asked key (expected_output.datasets names) or, if none were asked,\n   every output_provides key (a second handoff without new input is a loop). */\nfunction planMarkAgentActive(state, agentId, taskId, askedNames){\n  const plan=sanitizePlan(state.plan);\n  const id=String(agentId||'').trim();\n  const named=planItemForCall(plan, id, taskId);\n  const asked=sanitizeAsked(askedNames);\n  if(named){\n    named.status='active';\n    if(asked.length) named.asked=asked; else delete named.asked;\n  } else if(id&&!plan.some(p=>p.agent_id===id&&p.status==='active')){\n    const next=plan.find(p=>p.agent_id===id&&p.status==='pending');\n    if(next){\n      next.status='active';\n      if(asked.length) next.asked=asked; else delete next.asked;\n    }\n  }\n  state.plan=plan;\n}\n/* The plan item a call_agent names: action.task_id equal to an item id owned by that agent (or unowned).\n   Returns the item object of the array given (callers mutate it), not a sanitized copy. */\nfunction planItemForCall(plan, agentId, taskId){\n  const tid=String(taskId||'').trim();\n  if(!tid) return null;\n  const item=(Array.isArray(plan)?plan:[]).find(p=>p&&String(p.id||'')===tid);\n  if(!item) return null;\n  return (!item.agent_id||String(item.agent_id)===String(agentId||'').trim())?item:null;\n}\n/* A second call to an agent that already completed is new work — not a repeat — when it names an open\n   plan item other than the one the agent completed (CASE-6aa00e09-c6d71f: two results as two items; the\n   second call was sent to review as a repeat and the case finished without the next agent). Leftover\n   items of a completed agent are not open once its data already has every asked key, or — when\n   the call named no expected_output — every output_provides key (CASE-6aa029de-c5e23d: a second\n   handoff without new input is a loop; CASE-6aa00e09-c6d71f: facts-only without asked leaves p2\n   open). The plan is capped\n   (PLAN_MAX_ITEMS) and every step costs budget, so this cannot loop. */\nfunction planNamesNewWork(state, agentId, taskId){\n  const item=planItemForCall(sanitizePlan(state.plan), agentId, taskId);\n  if(!item||!PLAN_OPEN_STATUSES.includes(item.status)) return false;\n  const doneTasks=new Set(ledgerAgentEntries(state, agentId).filter(e=>e.status==='completed').map(e=>String(e.task_id||'')));\n  return !doneTasks.has(item.id);\n}\nfunction registryProvides(registry, agentId){\n  const row=(Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[]).find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===String(agentId||'').trim());\n  if(!row) return [];\n  let vals=row.output_provides;\n  if(typeof vals==='string'){ try{vals=JSON.parse(vals);}catch{vals=[];} }\n  return (Array.isArray(vals)?vals:[]).map(v=>String(v||'').trim()).filter(Boolean);\n}\nfunction leftoverCloseKeys(state, agentId, registry){\n  const asked=[]; const seen=new Set();\n  for(const p of sanitizePlan(state.plan)){\n    if(String(p.agent_id||'')!==String(agentId||'').trim()) continue;\n    for(const k of sanitizeAsked(p.asked)){\n      if(seen.has(k)) continue;\n      seen.add(k); asked.push(k);\n    }\n  }\n  if(asked.length) return asked;\n  return registryProvides(registry, agentId);\n}\nfunction agentDataCoversProvides(state, agentId, registry){\n  const provides=leftoverCloseKeys(state, agentId, registry);\n  if(!provides.length) return false;\n  const raw=(state.agents||{})[agentId];\n  const slot=raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};\n  const data=slot.data&&typeof slot.data==='object'&&!Array.isArray(slot.data)?slot.data:{};\n  const keys=new Set([...(Array.isArray(slot.data_keys)?slot.data_keys:[]), ...Object.keys(data)].map(String));\n  keys.delete('omitted_keys');\n  return provides.every(k=>keys.has(k));\n}\nfunction planMarkAgentDone(state, agentId, registry){\n  const plan=sanitizePlan(state.plan);\n  const id=String(agentId||'').trim();\n  const coverAll=agentDataCoversProvides(state, id, registry);\n  for(const p of plan){\n    if(!id||p.agent_id!==id) continue;\n    if(p.status==='active'||(coverAll&&p.status==='pending')) p.status='done';\n  }\n  state.plan=plan;\n}\nfunction planOpenItems(plan){\n  return sanitizePlan(plan).filter(p=>PLAN_OPEN_STATUSES.includes(p.status));\n}\n/* The plan as the Decision LLM (and the completion check) read it in planner_input. */\nfunction planLines(plan){\n  return sanitizePlan(plan).map(p=>{\n    const agent=p.agent_id?` — agent_id: ${p.agent_id}`:'';\n    const deps=(p.depends_on||[]).length?` (после: ${p.depends_on.join(', ')})`:'';\n    const note=p.note?` — ${p.note}`:'';\n    return `- ${p.id} [${p.status}] ${p.title}${agent}${deps}${note}`;\n  });\n}\n/* RAG tag branch from the plan (no regex over the goal): the open plan items name agents, the registry\n   names what those agents consume/produce (input_required / output_provides — artifact roles and data\n   keys). Routing cards carry the same role words in `topics`, so the cards for the agents the model\n   intends to use are boosted. Empty plan → empty tags → lexical/semantic branches only. */\nfunction planRetrievalTopics(plan, registry){\n  const rows=Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[];\n  const out=[];\n  for(const p of planOpenItems(plan)){\n    const row=p.agent_id?rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===p.agent_id):null;\n    if(!row) continue;\n    for(const key of ['input_required','output_provides']){\n      let vals=row[key];\n      if(typeof vals==='string'){ try{vals=JSON.parse(vals);}catch{vals=[];} }\n      for(const v of (Array.isArray(vals)?vals:[])){\n        const tag=String(v||'').trim().toLowerCase();\n        if(tag&&!out.includes(tag)) out.push(tag);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return out.slice(0,12);\n}\n/* Shape the callee should produce: datasets the Decision LLM named (latin identifiers, known field\n   types) plus consumers — open plan items of *other* agents and what their input_schema.data lists.\n   Domain-free: names come from the registry / the LLM, not from Excel or SCHEDULE. Empty → omitted\n   from agent_task.inputs (existing commissioning calls stay unchanged). */\nfunction datasetName(v){\n  const t=String(v||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[-\\s]+/g,'_');\n  return /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$/.test(t)?t:'';\n}\nfunction sanitizeExpectedDatasets(raw){\n  const types=new Set(['text','number','date','boolean']);\n  const out=[];\n  for(const item of (Array.isArray(raw)?raw:[])){\n    if(!item||typeof item!=='object'||Array.isArray(item)) continue;\n    const name=datasetName(item.name);\n    if(!name||out.some(d=>d.name===name)) continue;\n    const fields=[];\n    for(const f of (Array.isArray(item.fields)?item.fields:[])){\n      const fname=datasetName(f&&typeof f==='object'?f.name:f);\n      if(!fname||fields.some(x=>x.name===fname)) const t=String(f.type||'').trim().toLowerCase();\n        if(types.has(t)) field.type=t;\n      }\n      fields.push(field);\n      if(fields.length>=24) break;\n    }\n    const entry={name,fields};\n    const desc=String(item.description||'').trim().slice(0,240);\n    if(desc) entry.description=desc;\n    out.push(entry);\n    if(out.length>=6) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\nfunction expectedConsumersFromPlan(state, registry, calleeId){\n  const skip=String(calleeId||'').trim();\n  const rows=Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[];\n  const out=[];\n  for(const p of planOpenItems(state&&state.plan)){\n    const id=String(p.agent_id||'').trim();\n    if(!id||id===skip) continue;\n    const row=rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===id);\n    if(!row) continue;\n    let schema=row.input_schema;\n    if(typeof schema==='string'){ try{schema=JSON.parse(schema);}catch{schema={}} }\n    const needs=schema&&typeof schema==='object'&&schema.data&&typeof schema.data==='object'&&!Array.isArray(schema.data)?schema.data:{};\n    const cleaned={};\n    for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(needs)){ if(String(k).trim()) registry),needs:cleaned});\n    if(out.length>=6) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\nfunction expectedOutputForCall(action, state, registry, calleeId){\n  const raw=action&&typeof action==='object'&&action.expected_output&&typeof action.expected_output==='object'?action.expected_output:{};\n  const datasets=sanitizeExpectedDatasets(raw.datasets);\n  /* No datasets → omit the Consumers ride along only\n     when the LLM named a shape; they are never taken from action.expected_output.consumers. */\n  if(!datasets.length) return null;\n  const consumers=expectedConsumersFromPlan(state, registry, calleeId);\n  const out={datasets};\n  if(consumers.length) out.consumers=consumers;\n  return out;\n}\n/* One agent_result → case state. Domain-free: it knows statuses and slots, not agents.\n   Returns {status, next_status, should_continue, events, message}; the caller persists state/events. */\nfunction applyAgentResult(state, agentId, taskId, result, registry){\n  const obj=v=>v&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v);\n  const res=obj(result)?result:{};\n  const status=String(res.status||'completed');\n  const title=agentTitle(agentId, registry);\n  const fallback=status==='completed'?`Агент «${title}» завершил задачу.`\n    :status==='needs_input'?`Агент «${title}» запросил дополнительные данные.`\n    :status==='in_progress'?`Агент «${title}» работает над задачей; результат придёт позже.`\n    :`Агент «${title}» вернул ошибку.`;\n  const message=String(res.message||'').trim()||fallback;\n  const agents=obj(state.agents)?{...state.agents}:{};\n  const prevSlot=obj(agents[agentId])?agents[agentId]:{};\n  const step=Number(state.step_count||0);\n  const artifactsBefore=new Set(Object.keys(flattenArtifacts(state.artifacts||{})));\n  const events=[];\n  let nextStatus='running';\n  let shouldContinue=true;\n  if(status==='completed'){\n    /* A later completed call of the same agent overlays data keys; it must not drop keys a previous\n       completed call already fixed (CASE-6aa026d9-45db12: the second result had only new_wells and\n       wiped facts, so the next agent asked Q-facts). events.push({kind:'agent.result',actor:agentId||'agent',agent_id:agentId,task_id:taskId,status:'completed',status_message:message,\n      payload:{data_keys:Object.keys(obj(res.data)?res.data:{}),artifacts:Object.keys(obj(res.artifacts)?res.artifacts:{}),deliverables:deliverables(state.artifacts).filter(d=>d.producer===agentId),\n        issues:(Array.isArray(res.issues)?res.issues:[]).slice(0,6),assumptions:(Array.isArray(res.assumptions)?res.assumptions:[]).slice(0,6),...execRef()}});\n  } else if(status==='in_progress'){\n    /* events.push({kind:'hitl.request',actor:'orchestrator',agent_id:agentId,status:'waiting_user',status_message:q.question,payload:{...q,...execRef()}});\n  } else {\n    const prevErr=obj(state.last_error)?state.last_error:{};\n    const sameAgent=Boolean(agentId)&&String(prevErr.agent_id||'')===agentId;\n    const is recorded in the slot (status + summary) but never overwrites data a previous\n       completed run of the same agent produced. */\n    agents[agentId]={...prevSlot,status:'failed',summary:message.slice(0,400),task_id:taskId,step,data:obj(prevSlot.data)?prevSlot.data:{}};\n    const issues=Array.isArray(res.issues)?res.issues:[];\n    const unreachable=issues.some(i=>i&&String(i.code||'')==='service_unreachable');\n    events.push({kind:'agent.failed',actor:agentId||'agent',agent_id:agentId,status:'failed',status_message:message,payload:{message,issues,error_count:errorCount,...execRef()}});\n ledgerPush(state,{kind:'agent',step,agent_id:agentId,task_id:taskId,status,summary:message.slice(0,400),artifacts_added:artifactsAdded,data_keys:Object.keys(obj(res.data)?res.data:{}).slice(0,12)});\n {status,next_status:nextStatus,should_continue:shouldContinue,events,message};\n}\nconst COMPACT_INPUTS_MAX=12;\nfunction compactAgents(agents){\n  const out={};\n  for(const [id,a] of Python twin:\n   state_shape.compact_decision_context. */\nfunction buildCompact(state){\n  const artifacts=state.artifacts||{};\n  const plan=sanitizePlan(state.plan);\n  const hitl=state.hitl||{};\n Если продолжить — напишите, что именно нужно получить.`,\n    options:[\n      {value:'accept',label:'Принять результат как есть'},\n      {value:'rework',label:'Продолжить — опишу ниже'}\n    ]\n  };\n}\nfunction compactLedger(state){\n  const l=sanitizeLedger(state.ledger);\n  const rows=l.history.slice(-8).map(e=>{\n    if(e.kind==='human'){\n      return {step:e.step,kind:'human',question:String(e.question||'').slice(0,120),answer:String(e.answer||'').slice(0,160),...(e.review_accept?{review_accept:true,review_scope:e.review_scope==='agent'?'agent':'case'}:{})};\n    }\n    if(e.kind==='verification'){\n      return {step:e.step,kind:'verification',verdict:'rejected',uncovered:(Array.isArray(e.uncovered)?e.uncovered:[]).slice(0,6).map(s=>String(s).slice(0,160))};\n    }\n    return {\n      step:e.step,kind:'agent',agent_id:e.agent_id||null,task_id:e.task_id||null,status:e.status||null,\n      summary:String(e.summary||'').slice(0,240),\n      artifacts_added:Array.isArray(e.artifacts_added)?e.artifacts_added.slice(0,8):[],\n      ...(e.rework_reason?{rework_reason:String(e.rework_reason).slice(0,160)}:{})\n    };\n  });\n  return {history:rows,stall_count:l.stall_count,completed_agents:[...new Set(l.history.filter(e=>e.kind==='agent'&&e.status==='completed').map(e=>e.agent_id).filter(Boolean))]};\n}\n/* Plan (O13): the orchestrator's own decomposition of the goal — a short list of results to obtain, each\n   optionally owned by an agent. The Decision LLM writes it through `plan_update`; deterministic code keeps\n   it in step with what actually happened (call_agent → active, agent completed → done) and the finish guard\n   treats open items as uncovered parts. Python twin: state_shape.sanitize_plan / plan_open_items. */\nconst PLAN_STATUSES=[\"pending\", \"active\", \"done\", \"blocked\", \"dropped\"];\nconst PLAN_OPEN_STATUSES=[\"pending\", \"active\", \"blocked\"];\nconst PLAN_MAX_ITEMS=12;\nfunction sanitizeAsked(names){\n  const out=[]; const seen=new Set();\n  for(const raw of (Array.isArray(names)?names:[])){\n    const n=String(raw==null?'':raw).trim();\n    if(!/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,39}$/.test(n)||seen.has(n)) continue;\n    seen.add(n); out.push(n);\n    if(out.length>=6) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\nfunction sanitizePlanItem(item){\n  if(!item||typeof item!=='object'||Array.isArray(item)) return null;\n  const id=String(item.id==null?'':item.id).trim().slice(0,40);\n  if(!id) return null;\n  const out={id,title:String(item.title||'').trim().slice(0,200),status:PLAN_STATUSES.includes(String(item.status||''))?String(item.status):'pending'};\n  const agentId=String(item.agent_id||'').trim();\n  if(agentId) out.agent_id=agentId;\n  const deps=(Array.isArray(item.depends_on)?item.depends_on:[]).map(d=>String(d==null?'':d).trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,8);\n  if(deps.length) out.depends_on=deps;\n  const note=String(item.note||'').trim().slice(0,300);\n  if(note) out.note=note;\n  const asked=sanitizeAsked(item.asked);\n  if(asked.length) out.asked=asked;\n  return out;\n}\nfunction sanitizePlan(plan){\n  const out=[];const seen=new Set();\n  for(const raw of (Array.isArray(plan)?plan:[])){\n    const item=sanitizePlanItem(raw);\n    if(!item||seen.has(item.id)) continue;\n    seen.add(item.id); out.push(item);\n    if(out.length>=PLAN_MAX_ITEMS) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\n/* agent_id as the model wrote it → registry id (the model tends to write the agent's title instead). */\nfunction planAgentId(value, registry){\n  const v=String(value||'').trim();\n  if(!v) return '';\n  const rows=Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[];\n  if(!rows.length) return v;\n  const byId=rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===v);\n  if(byId) return v;\n  const byTitle=rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.title||'').trim().toLowerCase()===v.toLowerCase());\n  return byTitle?String(byTitle.agent_id):'';\n}\n/* Merge `plan_update` into state.plan. Items match by id; an item without id is rejected — the model wrote\n   «step 1 — agent X» prose instead of a plan row (CASE-6a9fa129-5ae077: the whole plan was lost that way).\n   Fields the update omits keep their previous value. Returns {accepted, rejected}. */\nfunction applyPlanUpdate(state, updates, registry){\n  const plan=sanitizePlan(state.plan);\n  const by=new Map(plan.map(p=>[p.id,p]));\n  let accepted=0, rejected=0;\n  for(const raw of (Array.isArray(updates)?updates:[])){\n    const item=sanitizePlanItem(raw);\n    if(!item){rejected+=1;continue;}\n    const prev=by.get(item.id);\n    if(!prev&&by.size>=PLAN_MAX_ITEMS){rejected+=1;continue;}\n    const merged={...(prev||{}),...item};\n    if(!item.title&&prev&&prev.title) merged.title=prev.title;\n    if((raw.status===undefined||raw.status===null||raw.status==='')&&prev) merged.status=prev.status;\n    if(!merged.title) merged.title=merged.id;\n    const agentId=planAgentId(merged.agent_id, registry);\n    if(agentId) merged.agent_id=agentId; else delete merged.agent_id;\n    /* asked is orchestrator-owned (expected_output names). The model must not set it via plan_update. */\n    if(prev&&prev.asked&&prev.asked.length) merged.asked=prev.asked; else delete merged.asked;\n    by.set(item.id,merged); accepted+=1;\n  }\n  state.plan=[...by.values()];\n  return {accepted,rejected};\n}\n/* Actions drive statuses (flags are the model's habit, actions are its intent): the plan item the call\n   names (action.task_id) becomes active — else the first pending item of the agent being called; when\n   that agent returns completed, its active item is done, and leftover open items it owns close too if\n   the slot already has every asked key (expected_output.datasets names) or, if none were asked,\n   every output_provides key (a second handoff without new input is a loop). */\nfunction planMarkAgentActive(state, agentId, taskId, askedNames){\n  const plan=sanitizePlan(state.plan);\n  const id=String(agentId||'').trim();\n  const named=planItemForCall(plan, id, taskId);\n  const asked=sanitizeAsked(askedNames);\n  if(named){\n    named.status='active';\n    if(asked.length) named.asked=asked; else delete next.asked;\n    }\n  }\n  state.plan=plan;\n}\n/* The plan item a call_agent names: action.task_id equal to an item id owned by that agent (or unowned).\n   Returns the item object of the array given (callers mutate it), not a sanitized copy. */\nfunction planItemForCall(plan, agentId, taskId){\n  const tid=String(taskId||'').trim();\n  if(!tid) return null;\n  const item=(Array.isArray(plan)?plan:[]).find(p=>p&&String(p.id||'')===tid);\n  if(!item) return null;\n  return (!item.agent_id||String(item.agent_id)===String(agentId||'').trim())?item:null;\n}\n/* A second call to an agent that already completed is new work — not a repeat — when it names an open\n   plan item other than the one the agent completed (CASE-6aa00e09-c6d71f: two results as two items; the\n   second call was sent to review as a repeat and the case finished without the next agent). Leftover\n   items of a completed agent are not open once its data already has every asked key, or — when\n   the call named no expected_output — every output_provides key (CASE-6aa029de-c5e23d: a second\n   handoff without new input is a loop; CASE-6aa00e09-c6d71f: facts-only without asked leaves p2\n   open). The plan is capped\n   (PLAN_MAX_ITEMS) and every step costs budget, so this cannot loop. */\nfunction planNamesNewWork(state, agentId, taskId){\n  const item=planItemForCall(sanitizePlan(state.plan), agentId, taskId);\n  if(!item||!PLAN_OPEN_STATUSES.includes(item.status)) return false;\n  const doneTasks=new Set(ledgerAgentEntries(state, agentId).filter(e=>e.status==='completed').map(e=>String(e.task_id||'')));\n  return !doneTasks.has(item.id);\n}\nfunction registryProvides(registry, agentId){\n  const row=(Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[]).find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===String(agentId||'').trim());\n  if(!row) return [];\n  let vals=row.output_provides;\n  if(typeof vals==='string'){ try{vals=JSON.parse(vals);}catch{vals=[];} }\n  return (Array.isArray(vals)?vals:[]).map(v=>String(v||'').trim()).filter(Boolean);\n}\nfunction leftoverCloseKeys(state, agentId, registry){\n  const asked=[]; Empty plan → empty tags → lexical/semantic branches only. */\nfunction planRetrievalTopics(plan, registry){\n  const rows=Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[];\n  const out=[];\n  for(const p of planOpenItems(plan)){\n    const row=p.agent_id?rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===p.agent_id):null;\n    if(!row) continue;\n    for(const key of ['input_required','output_provides']){\n      let vals=row[key];\n      if(typeof vals==='string'){ try{vals=JSON.parse(vals);}catch{vals=[];} }\n      for(const v of (Array.isArray(vals)?vals:[])){\n        const tag=String(v||'').trim().toLowerCase();\n        if(tag&&!out.includes(tag)) out.push(tag);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return out.slice(0,12);\n}\n/* Shape the callee should produce: datasets the Decision LLM named (latin identifiers, known field\n   types) plus consumers — open plan items of *other* agents and what their input_schema.data lists.\n   Domain-free: names come from the registry / the LLM, not from Excel or SCHEDULE. Empty → omitted\n   from agent_task.inputs (existing commissioning calls stay unchanged). */\nfunction datasetName(v){\n  const t=String(v||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[-\\s]+/g,'_');\n  return /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$/.test(t)?t:'';\n}\nfunction sanitizeExpectedDatasets(raw){\n  const types=new Set(['text','number','date','boolean']);\n  const out=[];\n  for(const item of (Array.isArray(raw)?raw:[])){\n    if(!item||typeof item!=='object'||Array.isArray(item)) continue;\n    const name=datasetName(item.name);\n    if(!name||out.some(d=>d.name===name)) continue;\n    const fields=[];\n    for(const f of (Array.isArray(item.fields)?item.fields:[])){\n      const fname=datasetName(f&&typeof f==='object'?f.name:f);\n      if(!fname||fields.some(x=>x.name===fname)) const t=String(f.type||'').trim().toLowerCase();\n        if(types.has(t)) field.type=t;\n      }\n      fields.push(field);\n      if(fields.length>=24) break;\n    }\n    const entry={name,fields};\n    const desc=String(item.description||'').trim().slice(0,240);\n    if(desc) entry.description=desc;\n    out.push(entry);\n    if(out.length>=6) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\nfunction expectedConsumersFromPlan(state, registry, calleeId){\n  const skip=String(calleeId||'').trim();\n  const rows=Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[];\n  const out=[];\n  for(const p of planOpenItems(state&&state.plan)){\n    const id=String(p.agent_id||'').trim();\n    if(!id||id===skip) continue;\n    const row=rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===id);\n    if(!row) continue;\n schema.data==='object'&&!Array.isArray(schema.data)?schema.data:{};\n    const cleaned={};\n    for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(needs)){ if(String(k).trim()) registry),needs:cleaned});\n    if(out.length>=6) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\nfunction expectedOutputForCall(action, state, registry, calleeId){\n  const raw=action&&typeof Domain-free: it knows statuses and slots, not agents.\n   Returns {status, next_status, should_continue, events, message}; the caller persists state/events. */\nfunction applyAgentResult(state, agentId, taskId, result, registry){\n  const obj=v=>v&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v);\n  const res=obj(result)?result:{};\n  const status=String(res.status||'completed');\n  const title=agentTitle(agentId, registry);\n  const fallback=status==='completed'?`Агент «${title}» завершил задачу.`\n    :status==='needs_input'?`Агент «${title}» запросил дополнительные данные.`\n    :status==='in_progress'?`Агент «${title}» работает над задачей; результат придёт позже.`\n    :`Агент «${title}» вернул ошибку.`;\n  const message=String(res.message||'').trim()||fallback;\n  const agents=obj(state.agents)?{...state.agents}:{};\n  const prevSlot=obj(agents[agentId])?agents[agentId]:{};\n  const step=Number(state.step_count||0);\n  const artifactsBefore=new Set(Object.keys(flattenArtifacts(state.artifacts||{})));\n  const events=[];\n  let nextStatus='running';\n  let shouldContinue=true;\n  if(status==='completed'){\n    /* A later completed call of the same agent overlays data keys; it must not drop keys a previous\n       completed call already fixed (CASE-6aa026d9-45db12: the second result had only new_wells and\n       wiped facts, so the next agent asked Q-facts).  issues:(Array.isArray(res.issues)?res.issues:[]).slice(0,6),assumptions:(Array.isArray(res.assumptions)?res.assumptions:[]).slice(0,6),...execRef()}});\n  } else if(status==='in_progress'){\n    /* events.push({kind:'hitl.request',actor:'orchestrator',agent_id:agentId,status:'waiting_user',status_message:q.question,payload:{...q,...execRef()}});\n  } else {\n    const agents[agentId]={...prevSlot,status:'failed',summary:message.slice(0,400),task_id:taskId,step,data:obj(prevSlot.data)?prevSlot.data:{}};\n    const issues=Array.isArray(res.issues)?res.issues:[];\n    const unreachable=issues.some(i=>i&&String(i.code||'')==='service_unreachable');\n {status,next_status:nextStatus,should_continue:shouldContinue,events,message};\n}\nconst COMPACT_INPUTS_MAX=12;\nfunction compactAgents(agents){\n  const out={};\n  for(const [id,a] of Python twin:\n   state_shape.compact_decision_context. */\nfunction buildCompact(state){\n  const artifacts=state.artifacts||{};\n  const plan=sanitizePlan(state.plan);\n  const hitl=state.hitl||{};\n rows=Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[];\n  const hit=rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===String(agentId||''));\n  return (hit&&hit.title)||String(agentId||'агент');\n}\n/* Engineer-facing text must be prose: no snake_case ids, key=value pairs, JSON braces, pipes, or «baseline». */\nfunction looksMachineText(text){\n  const s=String(text||'');\n  if(!s.trim()) return false;\n  return /[a-z]+_[a-z_]+|[a-z_]+=[a-z0-9]+|[{}\\[\\]]|\\w\\|\\w/.test(s)||/\\bbaseline\\b/i.test(s)||!/[А-Яа-яЁё]{3,}/.test(s);\n}\nfunction composeDoneSummary(state, registry){\n  const done=ledgerAgentEntries(state).filter(e=>e.status==='completed'&&String(e.summary||'').trim());\n  if(!done.length) return '';\n  const seen=new Set();\n  const parts=[];\n  for(const e of done){\n    const s=String(e.summary||'').trim().replace(/\\s+/g,' ');\n    if(seen.has(s)) continue;\n    seen.add(s);\n    parts.push(`${agentTitle(e.agent_id, registry)}: ${s}`);\n  }\n  return parts.join(' ');\n}\nfunction buildResultReviewQuestion(state, agentId, registry, reason){\n  const last=ledgerLastAgentEntry(state, agentId);\n  const summary=String((last&&last.summary)||'').trim();\n  const title=agentTitle(agentId, registry);\n  const lead=reason==='step_limit'\n    ?'Оркестратор исчерпал лимит шагов. '\n    :`${title} уже выполнил эту задачу, новых данных с тех пор не появилось. `;\n  const body=summary?`Результат: ${summary}. `:'';\n  /* The plan still has steps for agents that have not run: accepting this result closes only this\n     agent's part (review_scope 'agent'), the orchestrator goes on with the plan. */\n  const rest=reason==='step_limit'?[]:planOpenForUnstartedAgents(state, agentId);\n  const scope=rest.length?'agent':'case';\n  const restTitles=rest.map(p=>String(p.title||'').trim()).filter(t=>t&&!looksMachineText(t)).slice(0,3);\n  const ask=scope==='agent'\n    ?`Принять этот результат и продолжить остальные шаги${restTitles.length?` (${restTitles.join('; ')})`:''} или нужна доработка? Если доработка — напишите, что именно не так.`\n    :'Принять результат как итог задачи или нужна доработка? Если доработка — напишите, что именно не так.';\n  return {\n    question_id:`result_review_${Number(state.step_count||0)}`,\n    kind:'result_approval',\n    review_scope:scope,\n    question:`${lead}${body}${ask}`,\n    options:[\n      {value:'accept',label:scope==='agent'?'Принять результат и продолжить':'Принять результат'},\n      {value:'rework',label:'Нужна доработка — опишу ниже'}\n    ]\n  };\n}\n/* Completion check (a second LLM pass) said the proposed finish leaves parts of the goal uncovered,\n   and the orchestrator already had one more step to close them: let the engineer decide. */\nfunction buildCompletionReviewQuestion(state, registry, uncovered, verdict){\n  const done=composeDoneSummary(state, registry);\n  const gaps=(Array.isArray(uncovered)?uncovered:[]).map(s=>String(s||'').trim()).filter(Boolean);\n  const gapText=gaps.length?`Не хватает: ${gaps.join('; ')}. `:'';\n  const doneText=done?`Сделано: ${done}. `:'';\n  const lead=String(verdict||'').trim()&&!looksMachineText(verdict)?`${String(verdict).trim().replace(/\\.?$/,'.')} `:'';\n  return {\n    question_id:`result_review_${Number(state.step_count||0)}`,\n    kind:'result_approval',\n    question:`Оркестратор считает задачу выполненной, но проверка нашла пробел. ${lead}${doneText}${gapText}Принять результат как есть или продолжить работу? Если продолжить — напишите, что именно нужно получить.`,\n    options:[\n      {value:'accept',label:'Принять результат как есть'},\n      {value:'rework',label:'Продолжить — опишу ниже'}\n    ]\n  };\n}\nfunction compactLedger(state){\n  const l=sanitizeLedger(state.ledger);\n  const rows=l.history.slice(-8).map(e=>{\n    if(e.kind==='human'){\n      return {step:e.step,kind:'human',question:String(e.question||'').slice(0,120),answer:String(e.answer||'').slice(0,160),...(e.review_accept?{review_accept:true,review_scope:e.review_scope==='agent'?'agent':'case'}:{})};\n    }\n    if(e.kind==='verification'){\n      return {step:e.step,kind:'verification',verdict:'rejected',uncovered:(Array.isArray(e.uncovered)?e.uncovered:[]).slice(0,6).map(s=>String(s).slice(0,160))};\n    }\n    return {\n      step:e.step,kind:'agent',agent_id:e.agent_id||null,task_id:e.task_id||null,status:e.status||null,\n      summary:String(e.summary||'').slice(0,240),\n      artifacts_added:Array.isArray(e.artifacts_added)?e.artifacts_added.slice(0,8):[],\n      ...(e.rework_reason?{rework_reason:String(e.rework_reason).slice(0,160)}:{})\n    };\n  });\n  return {history:rows,stall_count:l.stall_count,completed_agents:[...new Set(l.history.filter(e=>e.kind==='agent'&&e.status==='completed').map(e=>e.agent_id).filter(Boolean))]};\n}\n/* Plan (O13): the orchestrator's own decomposition of the goal — a short list of results to obtain, each\n   optionally owned by an agent. The Decision LLM writes it through `plan_update`; deterministic code keeps\n   it in step with what actually happened (call_agent → active, agent completed → done) and the finish guard\n   treats open items as uncovered parts. Python twin: state_shape.sanitize_plan / plan_open_items. */\nconst PLAN_STATUSES=[\"pending\", \"active\", \"done\", \"blocked\", \"dropped\"];\nconst PLAN_OPEN_STATUSES=[\"pending\", \"active\", \"blocked\"];\nconst PLAN_MAX_ITEMS=12;\nfunction sanitizeAsked(names){\n  const out=[]; const seen=new Set();\n  for(const raw of (Array.isArray(names)?names:[])){\n    const n=String(raw==null?'':raw).trim();\n    if(!/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,39}$/.test(n)||seen.has(n)) continue;\n    seen.add(n); out.push(n);\n    if(out.length>=6) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\nfunction sanitizePlanItem(item){\n  if(!item||typeof item!=='object'||Array.isArray(item)) return null;\n  const id=String(item.id==null?'':item.id).trim().slice(0,40);\n  if(!id) return null;\n  const out={id,title:String(item.title||'').trim().slice(0,200),status:PLAN_STATUSES.includes(String(item.status||''))?String(item.status):'pending'};\n  const agentId=String(item.agent_id||'').trim();\n  if(agentId) out.agent_id=agentId;\n  const deps=(Array.isArray(item.depends_on)?item.depends_on:[]).map(d=>String(d==null?'':d).trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,8);\n  if(deps.length) out.depends_on=deps;\n  const note=String(item.note||'').trim().slice(0,300);\n  if(note) out.note=note;\n  const asked=sanitizeAsked(item.asked);\n  if(asked.length) out.asked=asked;\n  return out;\n}\nfunction sanitizePlan(plan){\n  const out=[];const seen=new Set();\n  for(const raw of (Array.isArray(plan)?plan:[])){\n    const item=sanitizePlanItem(raw);\n    if(!item||seen.has(item.id)) continue;\n    seen.add(item.id); out.push(item);\n    if(out.length>=PLAN_MAX_ITEMS) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\n/* agent_id as the model wrote it → registry id (the model tends to write the agent's title instead). */\nfunction planAgentId(value, registry){\n  const v=String(value||'').trim();\n  if(!v) return '';\n  const rows=Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[];\n  if(!rows.length) return v;\n  const byId=rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===v);\n  if(byId) return v;\n  const byTitle=rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.title||'').trim().toLowerCase()===v.toLowerCase());\n  return byTitle?String(byTitle.agent_id):'';\n}\n/* Merge `plan_update` into state.plan. Items match by id; an item without id is rejected — the model wrote\n   «step 1 — agent X» prose instead of a plan row (CASE-6a9fa129-5ae077: the whole plan was lost that way).\n   Fields the update omits keep their previous value. Returns {accepted, rejected}. */\nfunction applyPlanUpdate(state, updates, registry){\n  const plan=sanitizePlan(state.plan);\n  const by=new Map(plan.map(p=>[p.id,p]));\n  let accepted=0, rejected=0;\n  for(const raw of (Array.isArray(updates)?updates:[])){\n    const item=sanitizePlanItem(raw);\n    if(!item){rejected+=1;continue;}\n    const prev=by.get(item.id);\n    if(!prev&&by.size>=PLAN_MAX_ITEMS){rejected+=1;continue;}\n    const merged={...(prev||{}),...item};\n    if(!item.title&&prev&&prev.title) merged.title=prev.title;\n    if((raw.status===undefined||raw.status===null||raw.status==='')&&prev) merged.status=prev.status;\n    if(!merged.title) merged.title=merged.id;\n    const agentId=planAgentId(merged.agent_id, registry);\n    if(agentId) merged.agent_id=agentId; else delete merged.agent_id;\n    /* asked is orchestrator-owned (expected_output names). The model must not set it via plan_update. */\n    if(prev&&prev.asked&&prev.asked.length) merged.asked=prev.asked; else delete merged.asked;\n    by.set(item.id,merged); accepted+=1;\n  }\n  state.plan=[...by.values()];\n  return {accepted,rejected};\n}\n/* Actions drive statuses (flags are the model's habit, actions are its intent): the plan item the call\n   names (action.task_id) becomes active — else the first pending item of the agent being called; when\n   that agent returns completed, its active item is done, and leftover open items it owns close too if\n   the slot already has every asked key (expected_output.datasets names) or, if none were asked,\n   every output_provides key (a second handoff without new input is a loop). */\nfunction planMarkAgentActive(state, agentId, taskId, askedNames){\n  const plan=sanitizePlan(state.plan);\n  const id=String(agentId||'').trim();\n  const named=planItemForCall(plan, id, taskId);\n  const asked=sanitizeAsked(askedNames);\n  if(named){\n    named.status='active';\n    if(asked.length) named.asked=asked; else delete named.asked;\n  } else if(id&&!plan.some(p=>p.agent_id===id&&p.status==='active')){\n    const next=plan.find(p=>p.agent_id===id&&p.status==='pending');\n    if(next){\n      next.status='active';\n      if(asked.length) next.asked=asked; else delete next.asked;\n    }\n  }\n  state.plan=plan;\n}\n/* The plan item a call_agent names: action.task_id equal to an item id owned by that agent (or unowned).\n   Returns the item object of the array given (callers mutate it), not a sanitized copy. */\nfunction planItemForCall(plan, agentId, taskId){\n  const tid=String(taskId||'').trim();\n  if(!tid) return null;\n  const item=(Array.isArray(plan)?plan:[]).find(p=>p&&String(p.id||'')===tid);\n  if(!item) return null;\n  return (!item.agent_id||String(item.agent_id)===String(agentId||'').trim())?item:null;\n}\n/* A second call to an agent that already completed is new work — not a repeat — when it names an open\n   plan item other than the one the agent completed (CASE-6aa00e09-c6d71f: two results as two items; the\n   second call was sent to review as a repeat and the case finished without the next agent). Leftover\n   items of a completed agent are not open once its data already has every asked key, or — when\n   the call named no expected_output — every output_provides key (CASE-6aa029de-c5e23d: a second\n   handoff without new input is a loop; CASE-6aa00e09-c6d71f: facts-only without asked leaves p2\n   open). The plan is capped\n   (PLAN_MAX_ITEMS) and every step costs budget, so this cannot loop. */\nfunction planNamesNewWork(state, agentId, taskId){\n  const item=planItemForCall(sanitizePlan(state.plan), agentId, taskId);\n  if(!item||!PLAN_OPEN_STATUSES.includes(item.status)) return false;\n  const doneTasks=new Set(ledgerAgentEntries(state, agentId).filter(e=>e.status==='completed').map(e=>String(e.task_id||'')));\n  return !doneTasks.has(item.id);\n}\nfunction registryProvides(registry, agentId){\n  const row=(Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[]).find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===String(agentId||'').trim());\n  if(!row) return [];\n  let vals=row.output_provides;\n  if(typeof vals==='string'){ try{vals=JSON.parse(vals);}catch{vals=[];} }\n  return (Array.isArray(vals)?vals:[]).map(v=>String(v||'').trim()).filter(Boolean);\n}\nfunction leftoverCloseKeys(state, agentId, registry){\n  const asked=[]; const seen=new Set();\n  for(const p of sanitizePlan(state.plan)){\n    if(String(p.agent_id||'')!==String(agentId||'').trim()) continue;\n    for(const k of sanitizeAsked(p.asked)){\n      if(seen.has(k)) continue;\n      seen.add(k); asked.push(k);\n    }\n  }\n  if(asked.length) return asked;\n  return registryProvides(registry, agentId);\n}\nfunction agentDataCoversProvides(state, agentId, registry){\n  const provides=leftoverCloseKeys(state, agentId, registry);\n  if(!provides.length) return false;\n  const raw=(state.agents||{})[agentId];\n  const slot=raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};\n  const data=slot.data&&typeof slot.data==='object'&&!Array.isArray(slot.data)?slot.data:{};\n  const keys=new Set([...(Array.isArray(slot.data_keys)?slot.data_keys:[]), ...Object.keys(data)].map(String));\n  keys.delete('omitted_keys');\n  return provides.every(k=>keys.has(k));\n}\nfunction planMarkAgentDone(state, agentId, registry){\n  const plan=sanitizePlan(state.plan);\n  const id=String(agentId||'').trim();\n  const coverAll=agentDataCoversProvides(state, id, registry);\n  for(const p of plan){\n    if(!id||p.agent_id!==id) continue;\n    if(p.status==='active'||(coverAll&&p.status==='pending')) p.status='done';\n  }\n  state.plan=plan;\n}\nfunction planOpenItems(plan){\n  return sanitizePlan(plan).filter(p=>PLAN_OPEN_STATUSES.includes(p.status));\n}\n/* The plan as the Decision LLM (and the completion check) read it in planner_input. */\nfunction planLines(plan){\n  return sanitizePlan(plan).map(p=>{\n    const agent=p.agent_id?` — agent_id: ${p.agent_id}`:'';\n    const deps=(p.depends_on||[]).length?` (после: ${p.depends_on.join(', ')})`:'';\n    const note=p.note?` — ${p.note}`:'';\n    return `- ${p.id} [${p.status}] ${p.title}${agent}${deps}${note}`;\n  });\n}\n/* RAG tag branch from the plan (no regex over the goal): the open plan items name agents, the registry\n   names what those agents consume/produce (input_required / output_provides — artifact roles and data\n   keys). Routing cards carry the same role words in `topics`, so the cards for the agents the model\n   intends to use are boosted. Empty plan → empty tags → lexical/semantic branches only. */\nfunction planRetrievalTopics(plan, registry){\n  const rows=Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[];\n  const out=[];\n  for(const p of planOpenItems(plan)){\n    const row=p.agent_id?rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===p.agent_id):null;\n    if(!row) continue;\n    for(const key of ['input_required','output_provides']){\n      let vals=row[key];\n      if(typeof vals==='string'){ try{vals=JSON.parse(vals);}catch{vals=[];} }\n      for(const v of (Array.isArray(vals)?vals:[])){\n        const tag=String(v||'').trim().toLowerCase();\n        if(tag&&!out.includes(tag)) out.push(tag);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return out.slice(0,12);\n}\n/* Shape the callee should produce: datasets the Decision LLM named (latin identifiers, known field\n   types) plus consumers — open plan items of *other* agents and what their input_schema.data lists.\n   Domain-free: names come from the registry / the LLM, not from Excel or SCHEDULE. Empty → omitted\n   from agent_task.inputs (existing commissioning calls stay unchanged). */\nfunction datasetName(v){\n  const t=String(v||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[-\\s]+/g,'_');\n  return /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$/.test(t)?t:'';\n}\nfunction sanitizeExpectedDatasets(raw){\n  const types=new Set(['text','number','date','boolean']);\n  const out=[];\n  for(const item of (Array.isArray(raw)?raw:[])){\n    if(!item||typeof item!=='object'||Array.isArray(item)) continue;\n    const name=datasetName(item.name);\n    if(!name||out.some(d=>d.name===name)) continue;\n    const fields=[];\n    for(const f of (Array.isArray(item.fields)?item.fields:[])){\n      const fname=datasetName(f&&typeof f==='object'?f.name:f);\n      if(!fname||fields.some(x=>x.name===fname)) continue;\n      const field={name:fname};\n      if(f&&typeof f==='object'){\n        const desc=String(f.description||'').trim().slice(0,160);\n        if(desc) field.description=desc;\n        const t=String(f.type||'').trim().toLowerCase();\n        if(types.has(t)) field.type=t;\n      }\n      fields.push(field);\n      if(fields.length>=24) break;\n    }\n    const entry={name,fields};\n    const desc=String(item.description||'').trim().slice(0,240);\n    if(desc) entry.description=desc;\n    out.push(entry);\n    if(out.length>=6) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\nfunction expectedConsumersFromPlan(state, registry, calleeId){\n  const skip=String(calleeId||'').trim();\n  const rows=Array.isArray(registry)?registry:[];\n  const out=[];\n  for(const p of planOpenItems(state&&state.plan)){\n    const id=String(p.agent_id||'').trim();\n    if(!id||id===skip) continue;\n    const row=rows.find(r=>r&&String(r.agent_id||'')===id);\n    if(!row) continue;\n    let schema=row.input_schema;\n    if(typeof schema==='string'){ try{schema=JSON.parse(schema);}catch{schema={}} }\n    const needs=schema&&typeof schema==='object'&&schema.data&&typeof schema.data==='object'&&!Array.isArray(schema.data)?schema.data:{};\n    const cleaned={};\n    for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(needs)){ if(String(k).trim()) cleaned[String(k)]=String(v==null?'':v).slice(0,200); }\n    if(!Object.keys(cleaned).length||out.some(c=>c.agent_id===id)) continue;\n    out.push({agent_id:id,title:agentTitle(id, registry),needs:cleaned});\n    if(out.length>=6) break;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\nfunction expectedOutputForCall(action, state, registry, calleeId){\n  const raw=action&&typeof action==='object'&&action.expected_output&&typeof action.expected_output==='object'?action.expected_output:{};\n  const datasets=sanitizeExpectedDatasets(raw.datasets);\n  /* No datasets → omit the key (commissioning calls stay unchanged). Consumers ride along only\n     when the LLM named a shape; they are never taken from action.expected_output.consumers. */\n  if(!datasets.length) return null;\n  const consumers=expectedConsumersFromPlan(state, registry, calleeId);\n  const out={datasets};\n  if(consumers.length) out.consumers=consumers;\n  return out;\n}\n/* One agent_result → case state.
